description: Build an UNSIGNED swap transaction for the caller's own wallet: buy a token with the chain's native coin, or sell it back. DexSheet never holds keys or funds: pass only the public wallet address as `taker`, then sign the returned transaction yourself. Every quote includes a 0.5% DexSheet fee (stated in the result) on top of the route's own costs. The token is checked first: buying a token that FAILED the SheetScore rug check, or an old contract that migrated to a new address, is refused (selling them is allowed, with the warning first); tokens with no completed check (Unrated) are refused on both sides; Elevated/High-risk tokens are quoted with the warning first. Solana routes through Jupiter Ultra (returns request_id + base64 transaction; then call swap_submit). EVM chains route through LI.FI (returns transaction_request and, for ERC-20 sells, an approval transaction; broadcast them yourself). EVM buys can pay from another EVM chain with from_chain (bridge + swap in one transaction; returns the ETA, the bridge and a status URL). A symbol that matches several tokens returns the candidates instead of a quote. Quotes expire in about a minute. Limits: 30 quotes per hour per IP, about $25,000 per quote. Not financial advice.

amount.description: Amount of the INPUT asset as a string: native coin for buy, the token for sell. "0.5" or "0.5 SOL".

chain.description: Chain id, optional when token is a symbol or a listed address. One of: solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum, robinhood, hyperevm.

from_chain.description: Optional, buys of EVM tokens only: the EVM chain to pay from (e.g. "base" to buy a Robinhood Chain token with ETH on Base). LI.FI bridges and swaps in one transaction on that chain; the 0.5% DexSheet fee applies to the whole amount. amount is then in that chain's native coin. Default: the token's own chain.

side.description: buy = pay the native coin (SOL, ETH, BNB…) and receive the token; sell = pay the token and receive the native coin.

slippage_bps.description: Optional max slippage in basis points for EVM (LI.FI). Jupiter Ultra sets slippage automatically.

taker.description: Your PUBLIC wallet address that will sign and pay. Never a private key or seed phrase.

token.description: Token contract address (preferred), "<chain>:<address>", or ticker/name, e.g. "9BB6NFEcjBCtnNLFko2FqVQBq8HHM13kCyYcdQbgpump", "robinhood:0x39dbed3a2bd333467115de45665cc57f813c4571" or "FARTCOIN".

unit.description: Optional unit for amount; must equal the input asset symbol.

name: swap_quote
title: Quote a token swap (non-custodial, fee disclosed)
